part.text:
Fixed. The change in tokio/src/fs/file.rs:634 makes `File::poll_read` return `Poll::Ready(Ok(()))` immediately when the destination buffer is empty, instead of dispatching a zero-length read to the blocking pool whose 0-byte completion was then misreported as EOF on the next poll.

Validation:
- Reproducer scenario (empty-buffer `poll_read` followed by `read_exact` on `/dev/zero`) now succeeds; also verified real EOF is still reported correctly after an empty-buffer poll.
- Existing tests pass: `fs_file` (17), `io_read_exact` (8), `io_buf_reader` (3), `io_copy` (1), `io_read_to_end` (4), and the tokio lib tests (135).

The temporary validation test file was removed; the working tree contains only the one-line fix (plus explanatory comment) in `tokio/src/fs/file.rs`.
